result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 3, Article 5 (Transient Occupancy Tax), covering enforcement, revenue utilization and the additional voter-approved hotel tax, none of which concerns residential rental regulation.
result.notes: The source URL points to San Diego's algorithmic rent-price-fixing prohibition (Division 11, section 98.1103), but this part of the page contains only transient occupancy tax provisions (sections 35.0124 through 35.0204). It contains no rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposit, application screening fee, screening restriction or algorithmic rent-setting rule, so no records are extracted. The algorithmic-device prohibition text itself does not appear in this part and may be in another part of the document.
